intro: Romans 8 is about life in the Spirit: no condemnation for those in Christ, adoption as God's children, and a love nothing can separate you from. These songs answer it with freedom, belonging and confidence in that love.

songs.name: No Longer Slaves
songs.why: It sings the heart of Romans 8:15, that you have not received a spirit of fear but of adoption, crying "Abba, Father".

songs.name: Who You Say I Am
songs.why: It celebrates being a child of God and an heir with Christ, as Romans 8 says the Spirit bears witness you are.

songs.name: In Christ Alone
songs.why: Its last verse echoes the chapter's close: no power of hell or scheme of man can pluck you from His hand.
